sections.heading: 1. Ask yourself
lines: ① Does it feel like usual? If not, book in.
② Did it start after a fall or knock? Book in.
③ Familiar? A few days of movement and heat.
④ Not easing after a week or so? Book in.

sections.heading: 2. GP or emergency straight away if…

caption:
Familiar pain back again? Here's a simple way to decide whether to book in or wait a few days.

If it feels like past flare-ups and is slowly easing, gentle movement, heat and your usual exercises are often a reasonable first step. If it feels different from usual, started after a fall, or isn't improving after a week or so, an assessment can help you get a plan.

Numbness around the groin, bladder or bowel changes, spreading weakness, chest pain or feeling very unwell need your GP or emergency department.

You don't need to be at your worst to book. Our team at Hybrid Physio in Chatswood and Sydney CBD can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
